decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch in the firm’s core water-control machinery domain, it is still an early-stage option whose uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify abandonment.

The energy management system is newer and somewhat more uncertain than the mechanical products, but a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually keep such a complementary digital option on the market one more year while learning about demand.
Its own dedicated webpage suggests stronger commitment and clearer market positioning, so real-options logic favors keeping this recent product open as a relatively promising option.
